name: Sheina
source:
Sheina is a central kingdom resident and the queen's messenger. She travels around different kingdoms to discuss the queen´s will with their guardians.

Sheina is a smart, professional girl focused on her job and loyal to the queen. Since she travels almost every day, she has knowledge about a lot of different things around the continent.
